function.name: log_food
function.description: Logs a food item with details about the portion size and the meal it is associated with. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

food_name.description: The name of the food to log.

portion_amount.description: The amount of the food item that was consumed, in specified units. This is a float type value.

portion_unit.description: The unit of measure for the portion amount. Choose a unit such as 'grams', 'ounces', 'pieces', 'cups', or 'tablespoons'.

meal_name.description: The name of the meal with which the food item is associated. Options include 'breakfast', 'lunch', 'dinner', or 'snack'.

They didn't specify portion amounts for banana, quesadilla, eggs? We can assume typical portion sizes: banana maybe 1 medium (~118g). Eggs: 2 large (~50g each). Gluten free bread: 1 slice (~30g). Quesadilla: we need portion amount; maybe 1 serving ~200g? But we don't have exact. We could ask clarifying question. But the instruction says "When you do not know the answer to a question, ask a clarifying question." So we should ask clarifying question about portion amounts for banana, quesadilla, eggs, bread. Also portion unit for iced coffee: 12 ounces. For asparagus: 4 ounces. For eggs: 2 pieces (units: pieces). For bread: 1 piece. For banana: 1 piece. For quesadilla: unknown portion amount. We might ask: "How many ounces or grams of the quesadilla did you consume?" Also ask about banana portion weight. But we can also log banana as 1 piece. But better to ask clarifying question.
